learn.en: In liquids, heat weakens the pull between molecules (cohesion), so the liquid flows more easily — viscosity goes down.

why.en: Liquid viscosity comes mainly from cohesion. Gases are opposite: their viscosity rises with heat.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept), Cat. No. 517/2022, 610/2022, 613/2022 — 2023 (Q.P. 045/2023, 2023-05-26), Q1.

recall_q.en: Viscosity of liquids decreases when temperature rises. Why?

explain_simple.en: Hot coconut oil pours faster than cold coconut oil.

learn.en: Newton's law of viscosity: shear stress = viscosity × rate of shear strain (velocity gradient du/dy).

why.en: A Newtonian fluid (water, air) has constant viscosity, so stress grows in a straight line with the rate of deformation.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept), Cat. No. 517/2022, 610/2022, 613/2022 — 2023 (Q.P. 045/2023, 2023-05-26), Q2.

recall_q.en: In a Newtonian fluid, shear stress is ___.

recall_a.en: Directly proportional to rate of deformation

explain_simple.en: Newton's law of viscosity: shear stress = viscosity × rate of shear strain (velocity gradient du/dy).

learn.en: Fire point is always higher than flash point. Flash point: vapour flashes for a moment. Fire point: oil keeps burning.

why.en: To keep burning, the oil must give off more vapour, so it must be hotter.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept), Cat. No. 517/2022, 610/2022, 613/2022 — 2023 (Q.P. 045/2023, 2023-05-26), Q3.

recall_q.en: Which is correct about fire point and flash point?

recall_a.en: Fire point is higher than flash point

explain_simple.en: Flash first, then fire.

why.en: Uniform talks about place; steady talks about time.

explain_simple.en: Uniform = same everywhere. Steady = same all the time.
